_comment: Feature and window parameters follow the interim report's evaluation protocol (Table 3-1): 1.0 s windows with a 0.25 s hop; 10 log-spaced bands, 20 Hz to 8 kHz, from a 1 Hz resolution FFT (n_fft = one window of 16 kHz audio). Log spacing puts more bands where rotational energy sits; it was the stronger of the two spacings on fan (interim Table 4-1). See pipeline.py for calibration and threshold choices.
